svg.aria-label: One-arm dumbbell row, Reach: Brace one hand and the same-side knee on the bench, plant your other foot, and let the dumbbell hang from your free hand.
svg.title: One-arm dumbbell row, Reach: Brace one hand and the same-side knee on the bench, plant your other foot, and let the dumbbell hang from your free hand.

svg.aria-label: One-arm dumbbell row, Pull: Drive your working elbow back, keeping your torso steady.
svg.title: One-arm dumbbell row, Pull: Drive your working elbow back, keeping your torso steady.

svg.aria-label: One-arm dumbbell row, Top: Bring the dumbbell toward your hip without twisting your torso.
svg.title: One-arm dumbbell row, Top: Bring the dumbbell toward your hip without twisting your torso.

svg.aria-label: One-arm dumbbell row, Return: Lower until your arm straightens, then repeat on the other side after your set.
svg.title: One-arm dumbbell row, Return: Lower until your arm straightens, then repeat on the other side after your set.
